name: olivia-tech-website
description: Site institucional da Olivia Tech — consultoria de infraestrutura de TI em Brasília.

scripts.leads: npx --yes wrangler d1 execute olivia-tech-leads --remote --command="SELECT id, created_at, name, company, email, phone FROM leads ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.events: npx --yes wrangler d1 execute olivia-tech-leads --remote --command="SELECT label, location, COUNT(*) AS cliques, MAX(created_at) AS ultimo FROM events GROUP BY label, location ORDER BY cliques DESC"
